_about: Sources for scripts/build_roof_pack.py. Every source here was checked for a free, no-login service and its licence (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md). Areas are whole towns or neighbourhood-sized boxes, never single homes.

footprints.label: USA Structures - Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) and FEMA Geospatial Response Office
footprints.licence: CC BY 4.0 on the Esri Living Atlas copy; listed on data.gov as a U.S. Government Work

train.name: roofs_maine_2022
train.title: Training pack: house roofs from eight southern-Maine towns, spring 2022 (leaf-off)
notes: In a check of 200 random roofs, about 4% show no house (a wooded or empty lot, a pool area) and about 3% are unclear (deep shadow, a house under construction). Public building outlines and the spring 2022 photos were not made at the same time, and trees confuse the roof check.
The autoencoder exercise (ROOF-301, 'find the strangest roofs') tends to surface exactly these images: insurers use the same idea to catch bad imagery.

variety.name: roofs_us_variety
variety.title: Variety pack: house roofs from five U.S. regions with different climates and building styles
notes: A check of 75 random roofs (15 per region) found no empty lots. Larger homes, common in Florida and Arizona, can fill most of the 24 m square.
